run_sensor_pos: run sensor_pos to compute position-dependent sensor values for a Mujoco model and data
run_sensor_vel: run sensor_vel to compute velocity-dependent sensor values for a Mujoco model and data
run_sensor_acc: run sensor_acc to compute acceleration-dependent sensor values including contact and tactile sensors
run_energy_pos: run energy_pos to compute position-dependent potential energy from gravity and passive springs
run_energy_vel: run energy_vel to compute velocity-dependent kinetic energy as 0.5 * qvel.T @ M @ qvel
